prompt: Create a production iOS App Store icon for the pixel-art idle action game Star Junkyard. Use the references by role: Mo establishes the recognizable protagonist with orange welding cap and goggles, teal-orange work suit and welding tool; Rivet establishes the small round companion drone; Cancrab King establishes the scrap-can monster language; the back alley establishes the dark navy scrapyard palette and orange/teal lighting. Compose an instantly readable heroic bust of Mo lifting a brilliant five-point star energy core from recognizable scrap with Rivet assisting and a can-crab claw framing the background. Use strict chunky authored pixel art, high contrast and a limited navy, teal, orange, cream and star-yellow palette. Keep it readable at 64px. Produce a square fully opaque background with no text, letters, UI cards, rounded corners, transparency, photorealism or abstract-only geometry.
postProcessing: The generated 1254px opaque RGB source was resized with macOS sips to a 1024px sRGB App Store icon and 180/360/540px sRGB launch derivatives. No compositing or semantic repainting was applied.
